reproduction: Checkpoint, split, candidate-region and partition hashes were checked. Ungrouped, diffusion-0, random-0 and normalized-edge-0 final supports exactly matched the preceding grouping-control run; saved intervention logits matched within the stated replay tolerances. Diagnostic source hashes were verified after all three runs completed.

finding.mechanism: Diffusion-0 and random-0 exclude this addition because another higher-ranked edge has already represented its group. The one-per-group shortlist therefore omits an exchange accepted by ungrouped search.
finding.structural_control: Normalized-edge-0 retains the accepted ungrouped proposals at shared states and reproduces the ungrouped final support.

counterfactual.change: Append the omitted accepted ungrouped support once, at the matching second-step state, without modifying the predictor, partition, gradients or acceptance checks.
counterfactual.outcome: Both diffusion-0 and random-0 recover exactly the ungrouped final support and restore binary sufficiency agreement.
counterfactual.limitation: The candidate was identified using an ungrouped reference and the replay spends an extra proposal evaluation. This is a targeted inclusion intervention, not a new deployable algorithm, a matched-budget comparison, or a general fidelity guarantee.

tests_added: Recording snapshots leaves search outputs and traces unchanged and restores the original proposal function.
An injected proposal is explicitly counted and reported as extra work.
method_decision: The next method change should address candidate coverage, not merely replace the spectral score. Any coverage-preserving or restricted-diversity policy must be compared with ungrouped search at matched actual work; fixing this selected case is insufficient to establish independent coarsening value.
manuscript: Only the qualitative limitation and XZ20 diagnostic caveat were updated. Numerical experimental results remain unchanged.
